title: Opening up 'Zero-Knowledge Proof' technology to promote privacy in age assurance
summary: Google is open-sourcing their Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) technology to enable privacy-preserving age verification systems, allowing users to prove they meet age requirements without revealing their actual age or personal identity documents.
problem_solved: Traditional age verification requires users to submit identity documents, exposing sensitive personal data; ZKP enables proving age compliance while keeping age and identity private.
why_valuable: This approach protects user privacy while enabling compliance with age restrictions, addressing a critical gap in digital privacy for online services requiring age verification.
